info.name: DAVC Provisioning
info.summary: Provision selected users with DAV Connector accounts from LDAP or encrypted manual credentials
info.description:
Companion app for Nextcloud DAV Connector. Administrators can create multiple independent Basic-auth DAV profiles for calendars, contacts, and separate accounts. Each profile can read per-user credentials from configurable LDAP attributes or use one manually entered account encrypted with the Nextcloud server secret. Profiles target all users or explicit users and groups, and have independent schedules.
This compatibility-gated release supports Nextcloud 34 with DAV Connector 1.1.x only. Unknown DAV Connector versions fail closed.
info.author: Community prototype
